description.zh: SCU的新描述信息，长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头。
description.en: The new description of the SCU. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with [http:// or https://.](http://https://%E3%80%82)

description.zh: SCU的新名称，长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。
description.en: The new name of the SCU. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with [http:// or https://. It can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).](http://https://%E3%80%82%E3%80%81%EF%BC%88:%EF%BC%89%E3%80%81%EF%BC%88_%EF%BC%89%EF%BC%88-%EF%BC%89%E3%80%82)

description.zh: SCU所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the SCU. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 修改存储容量单位包属性

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-storage-capacity-unit-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --storage-capacity-unit-id scu-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --name testNewScuName --description testNewScuDescription --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs ModifyStorageCapacityUnitAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Description testNewScuDescription --StorageCapacityUnitId 'scu-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name testNewScuName
